Female Cheetah 'Radha' Released into Madhya Pradesh Sanctuary

Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav released a female cheetah, identified as CBC-2 and named 'Radha', into the enclosure at Gandhi Sagar Sanctuary. This marks the second female cheetah to be brought to the sanctuary.
